rows.what_the_ink_shows: In “Montrons que tout automorphisme g du graphe est dans Γ′”, the gamma is followed by a distinct short raised upright prime; a separate lower punctuation dot follows it. The prime is neither struck nor overwritten (crops/161-6_scan009_L1149.jpg).
rows.note: Keep Γ′ at this asserted conclusion. The proposed unprimed Γ is a mathematical correction of the author’s group claim, not a different optical reading. The row’s reflection example and automorphism-count argument were not independently proved.
